verdict.rationale: The public API and MCP layer for Mercury Books are explicitly described as future ('Soon, a full accounting API will make every core Books action available programmatically... an MCP layer will let AI agents handle bookkeeping tasks end-to-end'), not currently shipped, and probes confirm no live OpenAPI or llms.txt endpoints exist today. Since the capability is not yet available, there is no documented public API to drive the product currently.
